hypothesis: A hashed-feature logistic regression trained on the train families' evidence separates evidence belonging to an incident from irrelevant chatter better than the majority-class rate on validation families.

variants.description: LogisticHashed dim 4096, unigram+bigram hashed features, SGD epochs 30, lr 0.5, l2 1e-4; trained tonight on synthetic data on this Mac

config.labels: useful = the evidence source id belongs to any truth incident (labelled harness side from truth.json); irrelevant otherwise
